item.title: Risky Bulletin: Supply chain attack lets ransomware group inside 40 shipping companies
item.description: A ransomware group used a supply chain compromise to hack around 40 shipping companies, the Pentagon assembles a technology sabotage unit, PHP2Shell exploitation gets underway and GoDaddy revokes 400,000 certs.

item.title: Toronto crime tips org freezes operations after details of data breach come to light
item.description: Late Wednesday night the Toronto chapter of Crime Stoppers broke ranks with the national association, revealing a timeline showing what it knew and when along with an announcement that it will pause operations.

item.title: Resident Evil maker Capcom warns of phishing after 11.7 million records exposed
item.description: Exposed email addresses could put CAPCOM ID users at risk of phishing. Passwords were also changed without permission on 196 accounts.

item.title: Crime Stoppers chapter freezes tips after breach breaks anonymity promise
item.description: A Crime Stoppers chapter has stopped accepting tips after a breach exposed information about anonymous tipsters.
